title: Agent Loop Configuration
description: Configuration for one instance of the Generate -> Evaluate -> Refine -> Orchestrate loop: which hats participate, how evaluation is tiered, what the hard budget/veto guardrails are, and how refinement is routed. This is a reference configuration format (mirrors schemas/skill.schema.json's role for skills/*/skill.yaml); tools/run_loop.py is the reference implementation that executes it against the real Claude API -- see agent-loop/README.md.

hats.description: IDs of hat cards (agent-loop/hats/<id>.yaml) that participate in this loop's Evaluate ensemble.

mode.description: single-structured-call: one API call returns all hats' scores via structured output (cheap; the recommended default). per-hat-calls: one separate API call per hat (6x the cost/latency of single-structured-call; use only when a hat's rubric is complex enough to need its own full context window or when validating that single-structured-call isn't silently averaging distinct hats together).

pre_filter_output_constraints.description: Whether cheap, deterministic checks (e.g. a skill's output_constraints, see schemas/skill.schema.json and tools/guardrails.py) run BEFORE the hat ensemble at all. Recommended true: it's wasteful to spend an LLM ensemble call scoring an output that already fails an objective, free check.

veto_hats.description: Hat IDs whose failing pass_threshold triggers an automatic hard-fail (see each hat's own `veto` field, which this list should match). Declaring it again here, at the loop level, is deliberate: it makes the veto behavior visible in the config a reader is most likely to check, rather than requiring them to open every hat card to discover which one has veto power.

on_ceiling_reached.description: return_best_so_far requires the orchestrator to have archived every attempt's aggregate score -- see white_hat_archivist below.

improvement_delta_threshold.description: Minimum increase in the weighted aggregate score (see each hat's `weight`) required to justify another refine+re-evaluate cycle. Below this delta, stop and either return the best-so-far attempt or escalate.

strategy_map.description: Maps a failing hat's `lens` (facts/value/risk/feelings/creativity/process) to the hat id whose refine_strategy should be deployed to repair it. Every lens used by any hat in `hats` should have an entry; validated by tools/validate_loop.py.

condition.description: Free-text condition description; the reference implementation (once built) should express this as an actual predicate, not a string it has to parse.

reward_hacking_mitigations.description: Soft instructions ('don't apologize to inflate your tone score') are not guardrails and are not trusted here. Use structural mitigations instead.

judge_model.description: A model from a different family/provider than the one used for generation, so the judge cannot share the generator's blind spots.

white_hat_archivist.description: State/history persistence. tools/run_loop.py writes one flat JSON transcript file at the end of a run, satisfying persist_every_attempt in spirit but not as a live, queryable, or crash-surviving state store; this section documents the fuller contract a production implementation would need to satisfy.

history_compression.description: Prior failed attempts must be compressed before being fed back into a refinement prompt, and treated as untrusted prior output, not as trusted instructions -- see agent-loop/README.md's security note.
